stock.description: Value Convergence Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company, delivering a comprehensive suite of financial services across Hong Kong. Its operations are structured into six distinct divisions: Brokerage and Financing, Corporate Finance and Other Advisory Services, Asset Management, Insurance Brokerage, Proprietary Trading, and the Marketing and Sale of Digital Assets. The company provides a broad array of services, including brokerage and dealing for securities, futures, and options, alongside offering margin financing and money lending. It also undertakes placing and underwriting activities, and engages in the trading of equity, debt instruments, and various other financial products. Furthermore, Value Convergence extends its expertise to encompass mergers and acquisitions advisory, research, corporate services, insurance brokerage, asset management, financial and management consulting, registered office provisions, business administration, and company secretarial support. Notably, it facilitates the sale and marketing of digital assets, such as Q-coins, via its dedicated electronic platform. Established in 1986, the company maintains its headquarters in Wanchai, Hong Kong.
